items.html: *After we have explained the matter of Arich Anpin, we will now explain the order of his ten Sefirot, how they clothe Atik Yomin. We have already explained above that he is called Atik Yomin because his seven days alone are what clothe Arich Anpin. And this is their order: the Keter of Arich Anpin clothes the Chesed of Atik, Chochma clothes Gevura, and Bina clothes Tifferet.
